speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pregnant patient presenting with vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain. To ensure the safety of you and your baby, I need to ask a few questions. How many weeks pregnant are you, and how severe is the pain on a scale of 1 to 10?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (suspected based on prior C-section and painless bleeding, though pain is reported here) or Uterine Rupture. REQUEST IMAGES: Transabdominal and Transvaginal Ultrasound to assess placental location and integrity of the lower uterine segment. REQUEST TEST: Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring and Maternal Vital Signs.
